requirements.title: Verified corridor geography
requirements.acceptance: Pin official or provenance-traceable county-to-BEA crosswalk; print deduplicated corridor IDs, memberships, coverage and source hashes; no invented city-as-region rows.

requirements.title: Circa-2000 baseline and provenance
requirements.acceptance: Rebuild checked-in dataset from pinned sources; reconcile totals, units, suppression, estimates and source terms; distinguish data year from game start year.

requirements.title: Numeric units and balanced ledger
requirements.acceptance: Pass hand-computed borrowing, principal, capex, inventory and depreciation examples; checked overflow and rounding; every posting balances.

requirements.title: Stable entities and atomic commands
requirements.acceptance: Reject stale/generation-mismatched IDs, unauthorised and duplicate commands without partial mutation; deletion repairs references and reservations.

requirements.title: Deterministic session and canonical replay
requirements.acceptance: Linux, macOS and iOS match canonical hashes for same seed/accepted log including AI/RNG/queue state; batching and save boundaries do not alter results.

requirements.title: Households and background economy
requirements.acceptance: Finite household, government and external budgets and background employers reconcile; payroll affects demand; no infinite outside buyer.

requirements.title: Regional labour and wage competition
requirements.acceptance: Finite skill pools allocate without firm iteration bias; no double-employed worker; hiring, layoffs and wages have explicit timing and costs.

requirements.title: Production and inventory
requirements.acceptance: Inputs consumed once, output/capacity reconcile, shortages bind and perishable services expire; no negative inventories.

requirements.title: Market pricing and allocation
requirements.acceptance: Worked scarcity/oversupply/tie/import/no-demand fixtures conserve cash/stock and respect buyer budgets; revenue derives from actual fulfilled sales.

requirements.title: Freight and supply contracts
requirements.acceptance: Local/cross-region delivery timing, finite freight capacity, escrow, failed delivery and expired contracts settle once without teleporting stock.

requirements.title: Facilities and investment
requirements.acceptance: Build, expand, retool, mothball and sell post CIP/capex/maintenance correctly with lead times and cancellation treatment.

requirements.title: Investor career and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Player is separate from firms, retains unpledged assets after control loss, and can found or manage another firm without resetting career losses.

requirements.title: Subsidiaries and consolidation
requirements.acceptance: Deep/wide groups use correct voting control and minority interests; reject equity cycles; eliminate internal balances and unrealised profits without double-valuing assets.

requirements.title: Intercompany transactions
requirements.acceptance: Internal trade, lending, dividends and guarantees respect legal cash/authority; consolidated totals reconcile; internal markup cannot create score wealth.

requirements.title: Public/private shares and exchange
requirements.acceptance: Finite liquidity, pricing/impact, disclosure and cost basis; share totals reconcile; minority ownership grants no management cash access.

requirements.title: Issuance dividends buybacks and IPO
requirements.acceptance: Funding, dilution, solvency and treasury votes are correct; no double dividend or wash-trade profit; IPO changes governance/disclosure.

requirements.title: Boards and management authority
requirements.acceptance: Meetings, votes, CEO appointment/removal and bid responses enforce authority and deadlines; investor can lose management control.

requirements.title: Loans bonds and credit
requirements.acceptance: Loan/bond schedules, collateral, coupons, maturity and covenant defaults reconcile with lenders/holders and use explained ratings.

requirements.title: Playable banking
requirements.acceptance: Deposits are liabilities, loans are assets, reserve/liquidity/capital constrain business, and defaults/run scenarios preserve ledger identities.

requirements.title: Playable insurance
requirements.acceptance: Policy underwriting, premiums, reserves, expiry and correlated claims settle; catastrophes cannot be avoided by omitted liabilities.

requirements.title: Mergers and hostile takeovers
requirements.acceptance: Funded offers, escrow, diligence, tender/control transfer, minority payout and debt/contract transfer succeed or roll back correctly.

requirements.title: Antitrust review
requirements.acceptance: Group-aware regional/product concentration triggers review, delay, remedies or rejection; cannot bypass by subsidiary shell.

requirements.title: Labour unions and strikes
requirements.acceptance: Organisation, bargaining, strikes and settlements affect wages/output and worker incentives with explainable outcomes.

requirements.title: Lobbying and policy consequences
requirements.acceptance: Funded disclosed requests have bounded uncertain outcomes, cooldown and reputational cost; no universal exemption from law/default.

requirements.title: Bankruptcy and restructuring
requirements.acceptance: Grace periods, restricted payouts, seniority, collateral, liquidation and guarantees resolve; one failed subsidiary does not erase unrelated cash.

requirements.title: Fifteen differentiated industries
requirements.acceptance: Every DATA-CONTENT industry row has recipe/service/demand/cost rules, decisions and a playable tested scenario; names in picker are insufficient.

requirements.title: R&D brands and competitive strategy
requirements.acceptance: Funded bounded technology and brand/quality influence demand/cost over time; no guaranteed sales or negative unit costs.

requirements.title: Fair and bounded rival AI
requirements.acceptance: At least 30 rivals/five archetypes use common command permissions and observation fog; bounded deterministic work, urgent response and saved scheduler state.

requirements.title: Events and scenario content
requirements.acceptance: At least 24 meaningful event definitions validate prerequisites, choices, postings, cooldowns and narrative traces; founder and struggling-company starts work.

requirements.title: Versioned saves and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Atomic save, checksum, last-good fallback, migration fixtures, future/corrupt/oversized rejection and export/import pass including interrupted write.

requirements.title: Rust Swift integration
requirements.acceptance: Pinned bindings and fresh device/simulator XCFramework compile; Swift runtime session command/save/load/error tests pass without main-thread simulation.

requirements.title: Core phone decision flows
requirements.acceptance: On smallest supported phone, complete start, operate, inspect cash/profit, compare region, build/supply, save/resume entirely offline.

requirements.title: Corporate and finance phone flows
requirements.acceptance: Use phone UI to manage subsidiaries, shares/boards, takeover, bank/insurance, labour/policy and investor recovery with actor/cost/authority previews.

requirements.title: Sandbox and five-year score
requirements.acceptance: Score at week 260 explains metrics without intra-group inflation; continue sandbox to 30 years; career loss/recovery persists.

requirements.title: Onboarding and accessibility
requirements.acceptance: Real-rule guided start can resume/skip; VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, contrast, reduced motion and keyboard/narrow screens are usable.

requirements.title: Balance and adversarial careers
requirements.acceptance: Publish multi-policy/difficulty distributions over 100 five-year seeds and 20 thirty-year careers; investigate outliers and exploit scenarios.

requirements.title: Device performance and lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Measure A15-class engine/FFI/UI/memory/thermal/startup separately on representative/grown/stress worlds; background/termination/recovery pass.

requirements.title: Independent playtest acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Three independent testers finish five-year route and explain outcome; record defects and resolve release blockers; no fabricated fun signoff.

requirements.title: Release assets privacy and compliance
requirements.acceptance: Final icon, source/asset attribution, actual archive privacy manifest, policy URL, beta metadata, rating and export answers reviewed.

requirements.title: Reproducible Apple release archive
requirements.acceptance: Clean pinned build passes platform tests, fresh bindings and unsigned archive; signing/export path validated and symbols/provenance retained.

requirements.title: TestFlight processed and available
requirements.acceptance: Signed tested commit uploaded, Apple processing valid, intended internal group has build; exact build number and status evidence recorded.

requirements.title: TestFlight installed acceptance flight
requirements.acceptance: Real iPhone installs via TestFlight and completes offline start/save/control/recovery/five-year/continue route without release-blocking failures.
